title: Derby and top hat: the comedy routine with Stuff and "I'se a-Muggin'"
summary: Jones wore a derby and Stuff a top hat in a front-line sketch that began "I'se a-Muggin'" and was Stuff's first exposure in New York.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask you, when you started putting the derbies on your head, remember?
Yeah, I'd wear the derby and Stuff would wear the high hat.
And we'd work up front together.
Well, that's when you began 'I-se a-Muggin,' wasn't it?
Yeah, 'I-se a-Muggin', and all those things. So --
Well, that was really Stuff's first exposure in New York, wasn't it?
And it was yours in a way, too.
